description: NaO₆I(Pb)₂ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Pb clusters inside a NaO₆I framework. In each Pb cluster, Pb is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaO₆I framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent IO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.25 Å. O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.90 Å. I is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form IO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
